result.rejectedDefault: The play time was outside the normal range.
result.rejectedNote: No points were awarded. Want to try one more run?

typer.title: Night Typer
typer.tagline: Type the falling commands and break the firewall
rules: Type each falling command exactly, then press Enter
Every command that lands adds 20% to the firewall — 100% ends the run

phish.title: Phish Hunter
phish.tagline: Real or phishing? Judge like a sheriff owl
rules: Streaks pay a bonus, a wrong call costs 5 seconds
Each card has a timer — later stages get shorter

flight.title: Owl Running
flight.tagline: Match the colour, pick your size, save your wingbeats
rules: Hold to climb, release to glide (energy drains only while flapping)
Pass colour gates with the matching colour and shape — a miss costs energy, not your run
Grab 🪶 energy, 🟢🔵 size and 🛡️🌈 buffs to fly further

logic.title: Owl Logic
logic.tagline: Drop in gates and repair the locked auth circuit
rules: Tap a part, then tap an empty slot — the circuit runs instantly
Match the whole truth table and the puzzle clears itself
Solve with the fewest parts for an optimisation bonus; 5 in a row is OVERDRIVE

space.title: Owl Space
space.tagline: One hit ends it, a graze scores it
rules: Drag to dodge — firing is automatic (portrait)
Grazing enemy bullets scores points and charges your chip
3 lives. When it gets hairy, 💣 clears the screen

survive.title: Owl Survivors
survive.tagline: Stay alive and take down the boss
rules: Just move — every attack is automatic (landscape)
Pick 1 of 3 skill cards on every level up
Beat the boss to unlock the next stage
